title: Immortal Force / Mob Program MPforce
body:
Immortal command (Helper rank or higher):
  force <online player name> <allowed player command>
  force Sakura north
  force Sakura say Prepare for the Chuunin Exams!
  force Sakura @yawn
  force Sakura attack bandit
Administrators and Implementors only (limited safe social actions):
  force all say The Chuunin Exams have begun!

Mob program script command:
  mpforce $n <allowed player command>
  mpforce $n north
  mpforce $n say Welcome, student.
  mpforce $n attack bandit
  mpforce look  (older shorthand; targets triggering player)

Forces a normal command through the target player's real command dispatcher, not a fake movement or action. Regular game rules and checks still apply. Only online ordinary player characters in the PLAYING state may be forced; staff, offline characters and characters in editors cannot be forced. The target receives a notification, and immortals' successful force actions are audited.

Allowed: directional movement, look/scan, say/ask, native @social emotes, information/status commands, rest/sleep/stand, recall, ordinary combat attack/kill/flee and perform. Staff, account, bank/economy, equipment drop/trade/purchase, save, quit, world editor, force and other privileged commands are blocked. Recursive force loops are blocked. Bulk force all is limited to 50 ordinary players and basic harmless social/status commands.

Full documentation: docs/SMAUG_MOB_PROGRAMS.md.
